page_title: UDI 0-1 CRE | Udinese v Cremonese 17/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+2' Arthur Atta (Udinese) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
90+1' Alberto Grassi (Cremonese) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Milan Djuric (Cremonese) will replace Jamie Vardy.
87' The Michele Collocolo (Cremonese) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Gianluca Manganiello rules it out for a foul.
82' Substitution. Morten Thorsby will be replaced by Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese).
82' Marco Giampaolo decides to make a substitution. Youssef Maleh will be replaced by Michele Collocolo (Cremonese).
79' Today's match ends for Hassane Kamara who will be replaced by Abdoulaye Camara (Udinese).
78' Arthur Atta (Udinese) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
78' Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul after Alberto Grassi (Cremonese) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
77' Idrissa Gueye (Udinese) meets a cross inside the box, but Emil Audero wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
74' Arthur Atta (Udinese) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
71' Here is a change. Keinan Davis is going off and Kosta Runjaic gives the last tactical orders to Idrissa Gueye (Udinese).
71' That will be all from Lennon Miller who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese).
69' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
67' Relief for Hassane Kamara (Udinese) as the ref reverses his original red card decision and shows a yellow instead.

67' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Hassane Kamara (Udinese), but referee Gianluca Manganiello must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
66' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) makes an ugly challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
65' The resulting set piece from Udinese is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
65' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
60' Substitution. Jordan Zemura (Udinese) has come on for Juan Arizala.
60' Marco Giampaolo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with David Okereke (Cremonese) replacing Federico Bonazzoli.
60' Here comes a substitution. Tommaso Barbieri is given a rest as he is replaced by Romano Floriani (Cremonese).
56' Now Udinese have a corner.
56' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Udinese, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.
55' What was Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
53' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
51' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) was quite harsh and Gianluca Manganiello didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
51' Youssef Maleh (Cremonese) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
50' Youssef Maleh (Cremonese) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
49' Udinese take a short corner kick.
49' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Udinese.
48' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
46' Kosta Runjaic makes a switch. Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) is coming on in place of Christian Kabasele at the start of the second period.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Keinan Davis (Udinese) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Emil Audero makes a comfortable save.
41' Arthur Atta (Udinese) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Hassane Kamara. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
41' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 0:4.

36' A cross by Oumar Solet (Udinese) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
32' Keinan Davis (Udinese) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
31' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle. Juan Arizala (Udinese) commits a foul after dangerous play.
31' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
27' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Udinese as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
26' Referee Gianluca Manganiello makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Udinese. Let’s see what happens!
25' Sebastiano Luperto (Cremonese) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul. The referee blows the whistle and gives a penalty to Udinese!!
25' There's an opportunity for Lennon Miller (Udinese) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
23' Youssef Maleh (Cremonese) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
22' Youssef Maleh (Cremonese) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders. The ball is out of play and Cremonese manage to earn a corner.
19' Arthur Atta (Udinese) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
19' Filippo Terracciano (Cremonese) makes a rough challenge and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Udinese.
16' Udinese seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
12' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Youssef Maleh (Cremonese), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
9' 0 - 1 Goal! Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 0:1.
9' A pass into the box finds Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Maduka Okoye denies him.
6' Youssef Maleh (Cremonese) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
5' A cross from a corner kick by Cremonese is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
4' Alberto Grassi (Cremonese) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
4' Cremonese have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Udinese will have the kick-off.
